# varco run

Execute a probe plan against two endpoints.

## Usage

```text
varco run [options]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-body` | `string` | `2xx` | compare the body: 2xx, hash, or none |
| `-concurrency` | `int` | `4` | cases probed in parallel (1..64) |
| `-controller-configmap` | `string` | `ingress-nginx/ingress-nginx-controller` | controller ConfigMap as NAMESPACE/NAME (empty disables) |
| `-default-host` | `string` | `""` | host for rules that declare none |
| `-dry-run` | `bool` | `false` | print the requests a run would send, without sending any |
| `-exceptions` | `string` | `""` | exceptions YAML file |
| `-exclude-path` | `value` | `""` | exclude cases whose request path matches this glob (repeatable) |
| `-f` | `value` | `""` | Ingress manifest file, directory, or - for stdin (repeatable) |
| `-family` | `value` | `""` | run only cases of this family (repeatable) |
| `-format` | `string` | `table` | table or json |
| `-from-cluster` | `bool` | `false` | read Ingresses and the controller ConfigMap with kubectl get |
| `-ingress-class` | `string` | `""` | plan only Ingress resources of this class |
| `-kube-context` | `string` | `""` | kubectl context to use |
| `-kube-timeout` | `duration` | `30s` | timeout for one kubectl get |
| `-kubeconfig` | `string` | `""` | kubeconfig file to use |
| `-max-requests` | `int` | `0` | stop after this many requests (0 means unlimited) |
| `-namespace` | `string` | `""` | read Ingresses from this namespace (default all namespaces) |
| `-new` | `string` | `""` | new endpoint IP (port 80 for http, 443 for https) |
| `-new-http` | `string` | `""` | new endpoint for http cases (IP:port) |
| `-new-https` | `string` | `""` | new endpoint for https cases (IP:port) |
| `-old` | `string` | `""` | old endpoint IP (port 80 for http, 443 for https) |
| `-old-http` | `string` | `""` | old endpoint for http cases (IP:port) |
| `-old-https` | `string` | `""` | old endpoint for https cases (IP:port) |
| `-output` | `string` | `""` | write the report to this file (default stdout) |
| `-plan` | `varco plan --format json` | `""` | plan JSON from varco plan --format json (- for stdin) |
| `-profile` | `string` | `nginx` | nginx or generic |
| `-quiet` | `bool` | `false` | disable progress lines on stderr |
| `-rate` | `float` | `5` | maximum requests per second to either endpoint |
| `-repeat` | `int` | `1` | probe each endpoint this many times per case (1..5) |
| `-show-sensitive` | `bool` | `false` | show raw sensitive values |
| `-suggest-exceptions` | `string` | `""` | write an exceptions file for unstable fields (must not already exist) |
| `-timeout` | `duration` | `10s` | per-request timeout |

The help output leaves out a default that equals the zero value of the flag type; the table above shows that zero value.
